reserveReview.rationale: The independent Liquity-branch snapshot observed at 2026-09-04 enumerates the same four collateral branches as Felix's official CollateralRegistry. Latest HyperEVM calls returned 337,030.2850 WHYPE, 32,560.0295 kHYPE, 26.181784 feUBTC, and 12,220.7422 wstHYPE; DefiLlama prices normalized these to approximately 82.7%, 8.2%, 6.0%, and 3.1%. Each non-stable crypto collateral is classified as an exogenous asset with its protocol, bridge, custody, liquidity, and market failure domains.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent Felix branch balances observed at 2026-09-04 and valued with current DefiLlama collateral-token prices
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Every captured branch is identified and classified; the collateral assets are untracked exogenous cryptoassets rather than unresolved baskets.
